turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why did nobody call me before my son's mark changed?
Quick tangent. I'm negotiating my contract with the district next month.
Good luck with that. I'm here about Owen's zero, though. Who decided to enter it, and why wasn't I called first?
You negotiate for a living. Give me three tips. Quick ones.
I bill for that, and you're not a client. On what basis was Owen's zero entered?
